testsuite.name: UC20 Ophthalmology Appointment Requests
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: A patient and an optometrist or ophthalmologist HCP are registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 patient is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: The patient enters information about the appointment request and presses the Submit Request button . Ophthalmologist HCP Date Time Comments Type
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Views their appointment request
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 1: Views their appointment request
testcase.preconditions: A patient and an optometrist or ophthalmologist HCP are registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 patient is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: The patient views their appointment request. The patient can see the statuses of their appointment requests. The patient can select a request and delete the request.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: The ophthalmologist hcp views appointment requests
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 2: The ophthalmologist hcp views appointment requests
testcase.preconditions: A patient and an optometrist or ophthalmologist HCP are registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 patient is logged into the system.

step.actions: hcp: The ophthalmologist HCP views appointment requests. The HCP can select to approve or decline the requestion. The appointment will no longer be visible in the patient's appointment request view.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC4 - Alternative Flow 3: The ophthalmologist hcp view upcoming appointments
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 3: The ophthalmologist hcp view upcoming appointments
testcase.preconditions: A patient and an optometrist or ophthalmologist HCP are registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 patient is logged into the system.

step.actions: hcp: The ophthalmologist HCP view upcoming appointments.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message confirms the request.

testcase.name: TC5 - Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.preconditions: A patient and an optometrist or ophthalmologist HCP are registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 patient is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: The patient enters information about the appointment request and presses the Submit Request button . Ophthalmologist HCP Date Time Comments Type
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts that An error message is displayed if the entered information does not fit the data formats specified in 20.6. Otherwise, a success message is displayed.
